q1.explanationZh: daughter“女儿”，注意 augh 的拼写，gh 不发音。

q2.explanationZh: dawn 名词“黎明”，at dawn“在黎明时”；作动词 dawn on sb.“某人明白了”。

q5.explanationZh: day + time = daytime“白天”，in the daytime“在白天”。

q6.explanationZh: dead 形容词“死亡的”，动词是 die，名词是 death。

q8.explanationZh: deaf“聋的”，turn a deaf ear to“对……置之不理”。

q9.explanationZh: deal 作动词“给予；处理”（deal with），作名词“交易”，过去式 dealt。

q10.explanationZh: dear“亲爱的；昂贵的”，be dear to sb.“对某人很珍贵”。

q11.explanationZh: die 的名词是 death“死亡”。

q12.explanationZh: debate 既是动词又是名词，“辩论；争论”。

q13.explanationZh: debt“债务”，b 不发音，in debt“欠债”。

q15.explanationZh: decay“腐烂；衰败”，可作动词也可作名词。

q16.explanationZh: deceive“欺骗”，注意 c 后面是 ei（ceive），deceive sb. into doing sth.“骗某人做某事”。

q17.explanationZh: decent“得体的；像样的”，a decent job“体面的工作”。

q18.explanationZh: decide“决定”，decide to do sth.“决定做某事”。

q19.explanationZh: decide 的名词是 decision，make a decision“做决定”。

q20.explanationZh: deck“甲板”，on the deck“在甲板上”。

q22.explanationZh: decline 动词“谢绝；下降”，名词“下降；衰落”。

q23.explanationZh: decorate“装饰”，decorate ... with ...“用……装饰……”，名词 decoration。

q24.explanationZh: decrease“减少”，反义词是 increase“增加”。

q25.explanationZh: dedicate“献给”，dedicate oneself to sth.“献身于某事”，to 是介词。

q26.explanationZh: deed“行为”，a good deed“一件好事”。

q27.explanationZh: deep 可作形容词“深的”，也可作副词“深深地”，名词是 depth。

q29.explanationZh: defeat“击败”，既是动词也是名词。

q30.explanationZh: defence 是英式拼写，defense 是美式拼写，都表示“防御”。

q31.explanationZh: defend“保卫；为……辩护”，名词是 defence。

q32.explanationZh: to this day“迄今，直到今天”。

q33.explanationZh: in the daytime“在白天”，注意要用定冠词 the。

q34.explanationZh: daytime 作定语表示“白天的”，daytime flights“白天航班”。

q35.explanationZh: dead letter“（邮局无法投寄的）死信”。

q37.explanationZh: decrease 作动词“减少”，decrease one’s wages“减少某人的工资”。

q38.explanationZh: on the decrease“在减少中”，反义是 on the increase。

accept: to be rewarded for one’s good deeds
to be rewarded for one's good deeds
be rewarded for one’s good deeds
be rewarded for one’s good deed

q39.explanationZh: be rewarded for“因……得到回报”，good deeds“善事”，deed 是可数名词。

accept: the decline of the Roman Empire

q40.explanationZh: decline 作名词“衰落”，the decline of ...“……的衰落”。

q41.explanationZh: the best 后接名词，“进攻是最好的防御”，用 defence（美式 defense）。

q42.explanationZh: begin to 后接动词原形，“牙齿开始蛀坏”用 decay。

q43.explanationZh: in debt“负债”，“他欠了一千美元”。

q44.explanationZh: that 后接可数名词单数，“那笔交易”用 deal。

q46.explanationZh: We’re 后接现在分词构成进行时，debate 去 e 加 -ing 为 debating，“正在讨论”。

q47.explanationZh: be dear to sb.“对某人来说很珍贵”。

q48.explanationZh: were + 过去分词表示被动，“他们登顶的尝试失败了”，用 defeated。

q49.explanationZh: like to 后接动词原形，decorate ... with ...“用……装饰……”。

q50.explanationZh: 和 lamplight（灯光）对比，by daylight“在日光下”。

q51.explanationZh: 用现在分词作伴随状语，“发表演说为自己的见解辩护”，defending。

q52.explanationZh: fall 作系动词，后接形容词，fall dead“倒下死去”。

q53.explanationZh: a general 后接名词单数，“普遍的争论”用 debate。

q54.explanationZh: decline“婉言谢绝”，叙述过去的事用过去式 declined。

q55.explanationZh: 名词所有格后接名词，die 的名词形式 death“去世”。

q56.explanationZh: turn a deaf ear to“对……充耳不闻，置之不理”。

q57.sampleAnswer: As one grows older, one’s memory starts to decline.
references: As one grows older, one’s memory starts to decline.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q57.explanationZh: “随着……”用 as 引导状语从句；“减退”= decline，start to do sth.。

q58.sampleAnswer: He helped engineer the candidate’s defeat of his opponent.
references: He helped engineer the candidate’s defeat of his opponent.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q58.explanationZh: defeat 作名词，sb.’s defeat of sb.“某人击败某人”；engineer 作动词“策划”。

q59.sampleAnswer: In time of war, all the people thought it their duty to defend their country.
references: In time of war, all the people thought it their duty to defend their country.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: “战争时期”= in time of war；think it one’s duty to do sth.“认为做某事是某人的责任”，it 是形式宾语。

q60.sampleAnswer: It is proved that what the parents say and do have a deep influence on their children.
references: It is proved that what the parents say and do have a deep influence on their children.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “事实证明”= It is proved that...；“对……有很深的影响”= have a deep influence on。

q61.sampleAnswer: Everyone should be responsible for his decision, because life is a series of choices.
references: Everyone should be responsible for his decision, because life is a series of choices.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “对……负责”= be responsible for；“一系列的”= a series of。

q62.sampleAnswer: It is (high) time to take strict measures to deal with the environment pollution.
references: It is (high) time to take strict measures to deal with the environment pollution.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “是时候做某事了”= It is (high) time to do sth.；“采取措施”= take measures；“治理”= deal with。

q63.sampleAnswer: It’s not what you do once in a while, but what you do day in and day out that makes the difference.
references: It’s not what you do once in a while, but what you do day in and day out that makes the difference.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “日复一日”= day in and day out；用 It is ... that ... 强调句，not ... but ... 连接两个主语从句。

q64.sampleAnswer: Qingming Festival is an important Chinese festival to remember people’s dead relatives.
references: Qingming Festival is an important Chinese festival to remember people’s dead relatives.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: dead 作形容词“已故的”，dead relatives“已故的亲人”；用不定式 to remember 作定语。

q65.sampleAnswer: The committee declared that our school would be responsible for everything of the competition.
references: The committee declared that our school would be responsible for everything of the competition.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: declare that ...“宣布……”；过去的宣布，从句用过去将来时 would be responsible for。

q66.sampleAnswer: She hesitated whether to take the operation or not, so she didn’t decide to take it until her doctor assured her that this kind of operation had never failed.
references: She hesitated whether to take the operation or not, so she didn’t decide to take it until her doctor assured her that this kind of operation had never failed.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: not ... until ...“直到……才……”；decide to do sth.“决定做某事”；assure sb. that ...“向某人保证……”。
